Features

Built for the work
behind your business.

A connected set of tools for sales, suppliers, stock, money and reporting. Feature availability depends on your plan and the released application.

Sell

From the first quote to the final payment. Keep your customer relationships and sales paperwork together.

  • Quotes
  • Invoices
  • Customer accounts
  • Statements
  • Credit notes
  • Returns
  • Payments

Buy

Know what you have ordered, received and owe. Keep supplier workflows connected.

  • Suppliers
  • Purchase orders
  • Goods received
  • Supplier bills
  • Supplier payments

Stock

See what is on hand, what is reserved and what is available to sell.

  • Products
  • Stock on hand
  • Reserved and available stock
  • Stock movements
  • Reorder information
  • Inventory valuation

Banking

Turn statement transactions into a clear, reviewed picture of your money.

  • Import or manually record transactions
  • Review suggested matches
  • Confirm how transactions fit your records
  • Bank rules where enabled

Accounting

Bring everyday business activity into a connected accounting picture.

  • Organise accounting categories
  • Explore detailed accounting records
  • Check that accounting entries balance
  • See income, costs and profit
  • See what the business owns and owes
  • Review VAT records
  • Record accounting adjustments

Reports

Understand sales, expenses and stock without piecing together separate spreadsheets.

  • See income, costs and profit
  • Review sales and expenses
  • Follow customer and supplier accounts
  • See money owed to you and by you
  • Review stock and value-added tax (VAT)
  • Check bank transactions against your records

What your business owns (Assets)

Keep asset information organised, with accounting workflows appropriate to the released application.

  • Keep a list of business assets
  • Track their recorded reduction in value over time

Documents

Create clear, professional paperwork for your customers and your team.

  • Quotes
  • Invoices
  • Delivery notes
  • PDF and Excel support where implemented

Requisitions

Use assisted extraction to turn uploaded requisitions into information you can review.

  • Extract recognised information
  • Match recognised products
  • Review uncertain details
  • Human review before proceeding
Requisitions, with a second pair of eyes

Less retyping.
More careful review.

O-IBS can assist with extracting information from uploaded requisitions and matching recognised products. Uncertain descriptions, quantities and matches need human review before you proceed.

A considered workflow.

  • Upload a requisition.
  • Review extracted information.
  • Check recognised product matches.
  • Resolve uncertain details before taking action.
A clearer way forward
